ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy 83dce9a815b2 modified 'src/currency-service/config/production.yaml' and 'deploy/helm/currency-service/values.yaml', incorrectly setting FEATURE_FLAG_SERVICE_URL to 'http://featureflag-service.internal:8013/flags' (a non-resolvable internal DNS alias) instead of the correct Kubernetes in-cluster address 'http://flagd-service.svc.cluster.local:8013/flags'. This caused currency-service to be unable to reach the feature-flag service (flagd) on startup, forcing all feature flags to their default disabled state. The 'multi_currency_checkout' flag being disabled causes the /convert endpoint to return HTTP 500 for all non-trivial conversion requests, producing a 98.7% error rate.
ground_truth_remediation: 1. Immediately patch the Helm values override: set FEATURE_FLAG_SERVICE_URL back to 'http://flagd-service.svc.cluster.local:8013/flags' in deploy/helm/currency-service/values.yaml (reverting the change introduced in 83dce9a815b2). 2. Apply the config change via 'helm upgrade currency-service ./deploy/helm/currency-service' or patch the ConfigMap directly with 'kubectl patch configmap currency-service-config -p "{\"data\":{\"FEATURE_FLAG_SERVICE_URL\":\"http://flagd-service.svc.cluster.local:8013/flags\"}}"'. 3. Trigger a rolling restart of currency-service pods: 'kubectl rollout restart deployment/currency-service'. 4. Verify the feature flag client reconnects (look for 'Feature flag client initialized successfully' in logs) and that the /convert error rate drops below 1%. 5. Reset the checkout-service circuit breaker if it does not auto-close within 60 seconds.
